signatures.constructor_note_current: uint32_t d4vr_osw_constructor_note_current_v1(uint32_t note_tag, uint64_t raw_object, uint64_t interface_pointer, uint64_t root_pointer);

constructor_note_current: At exact trusted source site, core resolves bounded active-stack nearest genuine pending creator of the note_tag-required API (RootCreate tag2 or PSOCreate tag3). Must match actual current thread/context/ancestor interval and assigned-once association. Missing/conflicting/returned creator => terminal NO_PAYLOAD, no guessed token, no new mark or original argument. This solves state.c helper lexical scope without changing original prototypes. Token-specific note remains available for DeviceNEW tag1/baseCommand tag4 where wrapper token is actually in lexical scope.
return_protocol: Original scalar return (HRESULT/int/VkResult/UINT/ULONG/returned pointer or void) is captured by value before invoking any metadata helper; original return to its caller never waits for metadata success.

For a nonvoid original requiring output/association reads, invoke return_admit AFTER the original returned and BEFORE reading its output/building the result POD. It validates context/thread/slot/token. A valid committed token in OBSERVING yields OK + SELECTED + may_snapshot_defined_output1. A valid token in a closed/fault/drain state yields OK + DRAIN_ONLY + flag0; OK alone NEVER authorizes a read. Before_commit must have returned OK. No mark/counter/slot allocated by this decision.

Even when return_admit permits, read only if original API defines storage on THAT actual return (profile exact status0 for creation/parse; hidden-sret returned_pointer==actual caller_output!=0; pipeline lookup value!=0 for dynamic flags; source-owned locals remain valid by exact site contract). Source fields cannot be inferred from nonNULL alone.

For original-output read authorization, this decision is linearized at return_admit. A foreign terminal-fault latch may race AFTER authorization; it cannot make a permitted API-defined owned storage read unsafe nor admit that result into a closed frame. after validates again; no promise that absolutely no metadata read can occur after a concurrent fault instant. No new source marks or fake API.
Release after accepts token+actual ULONG ONLY, Destroy/other void after token ONLY; never return_admit to reread identity/device. All owners/raw inputs came from before.

If return_admit yields DRAIN_ONLY/flag0, or a guarded after builder fails, do not dereference output or reconstruct SourceAfter. Invoke drain_return once with the registered token. In NO_PAYLOAD/CLOSING/READY it retires live pending only. If still OBSERVING because return projection failed, first latch terminal unsafe-projection NO_PAYLOAD, then drain; the frozen raw snapshot is not invented or repaired. No fake scalar/null/RETURN row.

Normal typed after retires matched pending and records exactly one actual RETURN, unless frame already closed in which case it drains only. drain_return and typed after are mutually exclusive completions enforced by shared pending slot; duplicate/copy/wrong context never increments return twice. A valid untracked zero token causes no drain/accounting claim.
SOURCE_lifetime: No metadata before/after helper can retain a borrowed original pointer into sink storage. InputPOD is copied synchronously. Before helper lifetime ends before original; after helper lifetime ends before caller conversion/free/Release of API-defined storage. Return_admit authorizes only metadata attempt; it cannot prove object ownership beyond actual API/source preconditions.
before_receiver_consistency: Before_commit MUST cross-check the SourceEntryInput.raw_receiver detached at Enter against the exact original receiver field listed by event below. Mismatch is terminal unknown/NO_PAYLOAD, never retagging to another valid object. Corresponding command/internalowner/source-site fields must likewise agree with actual safely captured source association. DeviceCreate/RootParse have no receiver and require that field unobserved. ScopeGap is observer-only.
raw_zero_scope: Observed raw0 is preserved as original scalar0, never a valid ID/birth. Missing/unjoined relevant receiver/owner inside selected context gives unknown/NO_PAYLOAD, not a skipped state change. Only explicitly excluded NULL ModuleDestroy is outside selected membership before tick. Numerical coincidence across handle domains does not make an association.
